strings.ai.backgroundInfo: Conversations and screenshots are stored encrypted on this device only; the server only forwards model requests. Tasks pause while the app is in the background; send a message to continue.
strings.ai.deleteMessage: Delete this conversation and its screenshots from this device?
strings.ai.disabled: AI is not enabled for your account
strings.ai.inputHint: Tell the agent what to do
strings.ai.modeInfo:
Read only: only reads files, lists, screenshots and read-only commands.
Confirm every step: anything that changes state waits for you.
Confirm risky actions (default): safe and normal actions run, dangerous or unclear ones wait for you.
Full trust: everything runs except the forbidden list; can expire.
The effective level is the strictest of this choice, the administrator limit and the device owner limit.
strings.ai.planFirstInfo: The model first replies with a plan only. Execution starts after you approve it.
strings.ai.targetsInfo: The agent connects to every selected target before the conversation starts. SSH hosts use the password or key saved in your vault; connect once from the Hosts page first if a password must be entered.
strings.ai.visionInfo: Models without vision cannot read screenshots. They can only operate graphical apps through the accessibility tree; if that is not enough, pick a vision model.
strings.appLock.unavailable: Set up a passcode on this device first
strings.approve.similarInfo:
Allow similar: actions of the same kind and risk run without asking for the rest of this conversation.
Deny: you can tell the agent why; it will look for another way.
strings.assist.info: A device that is not signed in shows a device code and a verification code. The verification code is only shown on that screen and never passes through the server. The other person must tap Allow before the connection starts.
strings.assist.title: Remote assistance
strings.assist.waiting: Waiting for the other person to tap Allow…
strings.auth.agentInfo: SSH agent authentication is not supported by the core yet. Choose password or key to connect.
strings.auth.info:
Password: saved in your end-to-end encrypted vault, or asked each time when left empty.
Key: uses a private key from the Keychain page.
Interactive: answers server prompts (for example one-time codes) when connecting.
strings.credentials.info: Passwords and private keys are encrypted on this device before they are synced. The server only stores ciphertext; any of your signed-in devices can use them.
strings.device.removeMessage: Remove {0} from your account? It will be signed out remotely.
strings.field.label: Label
strings.files.deleteDirMessage: The folder and everything inside it will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
strings.files.name: Name
strings.folder.deleteMessage: Delete folder "{0}"? Its items move up one level.
strings.folder.name: Folder name
strings.hostKey.changedInfo: Only trust the new key if you know the server was reinstalled or its key was rotated. Otherwise cancel and check with the administrator.
strings.hostKey.changedWarning: The host key is different from the one you trusted before. Someone may be impersonating this server.
strings.hostKey.info: This is the first connection to this host. Compare the fingerprint with the one shown on the server (ssh-keygen -lf) before trusting it. Trusted keys are saved in your vault.
strings.hostKey.title: Unknown host
strings.jump.info: Reach a host inside a private network through one of your devices running LemonGalaxy, or through another SSH host (jump host, up to 3 levels).
strings.knownHosts.forgetMessage: Forget the host key of {0}? You will be asked to confirm it again on the next connection.
strings.knownHosts.info: Host keys you confirmed for SSH hosts. A changed key may mean someone is impersonating the server.
strings.lock.title: LemonGalaxy is locked
strings.login.changeInfo: After you set a new password, neither the administrator nor the server can learn it. If you forget it, only the administrator can reset it.
strings.login.changePrompt: First sign-in: choose your own password
strings.login.mockInfo:
This build uses the mock core and never contacts a server.
• Any username and password signs in
• Usernames containing totp ask for a 6-digit code
• Usernames containing new must change the password
• Password wrong simulates a bad password
strings.login.revoked: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
strings.login.scanInvalid: This QR code is not a LemonGalaxy server address
strings.login.scanPrompt: Point the camera at the server QR code in the admin console
strings.login.serverInfo: The administrator copies this address from the Overview page of the admin console. It includes the server certificate fingerprint, which proves you are talking to your own server. You can also scan the QR code shown there.
strings.login.title: Sign in
strings.login.totpInfo: Open your authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator or 1Password) and enter the 6-digit code shown for LemonGalaxy.
strings.login.totpPrompt: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator
strings.logout.message: Sign out of this device? Open sessions are closed.
strings.move.title: Move "{0}"
strings.rdp.appMissingMessage: RDP hosts open in Microsoft's free Windows App. Install it from the App Store, then try again.
strings.rdp.forwardInfo: The remote desktop is forwarded through your LemonGalaxy device to this local port. Windows App connects to 127.0.0.1 on this iPhone or iPad. The password is not passed along; enter it in Windows App.
strings.rdp.info: RDP hosts open in Microsoft's Windows App (formerly Remote Desktop). LemonGalaxy passes only the address and user name; enter the password in Windows App. With Connect via a device, the connection is forwarded through that device to a temporary port on this iPhone or iPad.
strings.rdp.suspendInfo: Forwarding runs inside LemonGalaxy. iOS suspends LemonGalaxy shortly after you switch to Windows App, so the forwarded connection may drop; on iPad, keeping LemonGalaxy open side by side helps. Stop forwarding when you are done. All forwarding stops when you sign out.
strings.rdp.suspendWarning: After you switch to Windows App, iOS suspends LemonGalaxy and the forwarding may stop.
strings.remote.modeInfo:
Touch: tap where you want to click, long-press to right-click, drag to drag.
Trackpad: move the pointer like a trackpad. One-finger tap = left click, two-finger tap = right click, two-finger drag = scroll, long-press then move = drag.
Pinch to zoom. While zoomed in, two-finger drag pans in touch mode; in trackpad mode the view follows the pointer.
A hardware keyboard, mouse or trackpad works directly on iPad.
Privacy (when the device supports it): blanks the device's own screen and blocks its local keyboard and mouse; it turns off when you disconnect.
Sound (when the device supports it): plays the device's sound on this phone or iPad; your choice is remembered.
Record: saves the screen as an MP4 (with sound while you are listening) to LemonGalaxy › Recordings in the Files app; it stops automatically when you leave the screen, switch apps or disconnect.
strings.remote.noDisplay: This device has no display to share
strings.remote.photosDenied: LemonGalaxy is not allowed to add to Photos. Allow it in Settings.
strings.remote.privacyFailed: Could not switch the privacy screen: {0}
strings.remote.recordAutoSaved: Recording stopped and saved to LemonGalaxy › Recordings in the Files app
strings.remote.recordEmpty: Nothing was recorded yet, so no file was saved
strings.remote.recordSavedMessage:
Length {0} · {1}
You can also find it in the Files app under LemonGalaxy › Recordings.
strings.remote.soundFailed: Could not play the remote sound: {0}
strings.scan.denied: Allow camera access in Settings to scan
strings.secret.info: What you type goes straight to the remote device. The model never sees it and it is not stored in the conversation.
strings.secret.title: Password required
strings.session.title: Sessions
strings.settings.appLockInfo: Require Face ID, Touch ID or the device passcode when opening the app or returning to it.
strings.snippets.info: Snippets are reusable commands. In a terminal, tap the snippet key above the keyboard to run one or insert it without pressing Enter.
strings.snippets.title: Snippets
strings.sort.name: Name
strings.ssh.secretInfo: Your answer is sent to the SSH server only for this sign-in. Save the password in the host editor to skip this prompt.
strings.status.info:
Green: online through the server. Blue: found on the local network (works even if the server is unreachable). Grey: offline.
Tap a device to choose remote desktop, terminal, files or the AI agent. Long-press for more.
strings.terminal.detached: Detached. The session keeps running on the device.
strings.terminal.killConfirm: End this session? Programs running in it are stopped.
strings.terminal.noRemoteSessions: No other sessions on this device
strings.terminal.sessionsInfo: Sessions keep running on the remote device after you disconnect. Resume them later from this phone or from another computer.
strings.totp.disablePrompt: Enter a current code to turn it off.
strings.totp.setupInfo: Add this key to your authenticator app (or open it directly if one is installed on this device), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
strings.transfers.info: Transfers resume where they stopped. Downloads are saved to Files › On My iPhone › LemonGalaxy › Downloads.
strings.wake.info: A device on the same network as the target (this phone or another online device) sends a Wake-on-LAN packet. Turn on Wake-on-LAN in the target's BIOS / UEFI or network adapter settings and keep it plugged in and wired; some machines cannot be woken from a full shutdown. The device shows as online once it has started.
strings.wake.sentLocal: Wake-up packet sent from this device
